caption: Own server progress: combat works. Enemies from the game's own data can be spawned (soldiers, Aranhas, Brontodons) with their real models, names, factions and weapons. You can shoot them (weapon damage from game data, floating damage numbers) and they fight back: creatures close in and bite, soldiers keep their distance and fire at their weapon's rate. Enemy health and damage scale with level from the original level tables, and the death screen shows who killed you. Also fixed: Meteor Strike launch and impact, flashing energy bar, screen shake. Next: terrain and walls for enemies and shots, then animations.
